title: ANATOMICA shell geometry manifest — Milestone 16
canonical_frame: centimetres; x+ = subject right, y+ = up, z+ = anterior
draw_strategy: one merged static buffer set per layer (positions float32, normals int8 snorm, per-vertex record slot uint32, indices uint32, unique-edge index buffer for wireframe); one draw call per layer when no region filter is active (plus one LINES draw per layer with wireframe on), per-record range draws when filtered
